description: This PHP file defines the OutcomeByMonthDashlet class, a dashboard widget for visualizing opportunities data over months in SuiteCRM. It extends DashletGenericChart and includes methods for constructing database queries, preparing chart data, and rendering a chart with JavaScript.

classes.name: OutcomeByMonthDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying a stacked bar chart of opportunities by month and sales stage in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default start and end dates if not provided.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays options for selecting opportunity IDs, defaulting to current user if none selected.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML and JavaScript code to render the chart with opportunity data.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by month and sales stage.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into a format suitable for chart rendering, including labels, data points, and tooltips.
